path_removal: Private absolute execution paths and training environments are omitted, not rewritten as original provenance. Source file identities use repository-relative names; the input inventory uses study-relative names. Original byte hashes remain authoritative.
scope: Reduced public provenance and complete numeric evidence, not original execution records or a resumable study. All nine fixed update-5000 fits and both scoring variants are retained without score-based selection or seed pooling. Checkpoint payloads, source pins, chunk unions and score reductions are checked read-only. Learned samples are not rescored. No training, denoising or new reference realization is performed.
